pergunta: What advice did Audrey give to Andrew regarding grooming Toby?
ouro: Grooming slowly and gently, paying attention to sensitive areas like ears and paws. And remember to stay patient and positive throughout the grooming process.

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 11:05 am on 4 August, 2023
[D14:23] Andrew: Yeah, having someone who enjoys similar things would be great for hiking. Do you have any advice for city-dwellers that owns a pup?
[D14:24] Audrey: My advice would be to make sure you have enough time and energy for a pup - they need lots of attention and walks! Especially for a German Shepherd like Toby, he'll need to offset a lot of energy.
[D14:25] Andrew: Thanks for the advice! I'll definitely keep that in mind. I want to make sure I'm not limiting Toby's growth but not taking him out not enough.
[D14:26] Audrey: No worries, Andrew! It's important to be prepared and give a pup the love it deserves. Good luck with Toby!
[D14:27] Andrew: Thanks! Gotta take Toby out for a small hike at the local trail. Ttyl!
[...]
Session date: 9:58 pm on 16 August, 2023
[D15:2] Andrew: Wow that's so cool! I recently went to a farm with my girlfriend to get some fresh veggies for dinner, and it was really nice. Have you been thinking about getting more fur babies or is four enough?
[D15:3] Audrey: Sounds great! I'd love to have more, but four is enough for now. They keep me busy and I want to make sure I give each of them the attention they deserve - four dogs is already a lot! I took them all to the vet and got them checked up, it was such a havoc that next time I'll bring them one by one.
[D15:4] Andrew: Oof, that vet trip must have been chaotic. Yeah I'm sure they keep you busy! That photo you shared was sweet - do they have a favorite spot to relax?
[...]
Session date: 9:19 pm on 19 August, 2023
[D16:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, hope you're doing good! So I've decided to take a break from work yesterday and check out a new cafe. It was a nice change and reminded me of how the great outdoors is always there to offer you peace. Here's a photo from my last hike - so serene! How's your month been so far?
[D16:2] Audrey: Hi Andrew! The cafe sounds great, and the hike pic's great! August's been eventful - I learned a new skill! It was really awesome, making sure they were pampered and happy. I've always loved caring for my pups, and now taking care of their grooming myself makes me closer to them. They look so cute post-grooming!
[D16:3] Andrew: Wow that's awesome! You're doing an amazing job taking care of your pups. Can you show me a pic of them after the grooming? I bet they look adorable!
[...]
[D16:9] Andrew: Cool tips! I'll remember them if I ever get to groom Toby. Thanks!
[D16:10] Audrey: No problem, glad the tips helped. If you ever give it a shot, let me know and I can provide more advice.
[D16:11] Andrew: Thanks! I'll let you know if I decide to give it a try. Appreciate your help. What are your plans for the weekend?

Session date: 12:24 am on 24 August, 2023
[D17:3] Andrew: Wow, they look like they're loving the mountain life. How do you keep them looking good out there?
[D17:4] Audrey: Yeah they really do enjoy the mountain life. Regular grooming is essential to keep them looking good. Daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims, and lots of love is what helps them stay healthy and happy. It's all about keeping them in good shape.
[D17:5] Andrew: Awesome! Sounds like you're doing a great job taking care of them. Making sure they stay healthy and happy is key.
[...]
[D17:15] Andrew: Got it. Thanks for that reminder.
[D17:16] Audrey: No problem. Let me know if you have any questions or need advice.
[D17:17] Andrew: Yep, Audrey. Thanks for everything - you rock! Here's a pic of Toby.
[...]
Session date: 7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D18:9] Andrew: That's so heartwarming! Seeing them enjoy themselves like that is always a joy. :)
[D18:10] Audrey: I'm so happy seeing them have a great time. Last week I even got some new beds for them, just to give them some extra comfort now the weather's cooling down and they were happy! It's incredible how such a simple thing can bring them so much happiness.
[D18:11] Andrew: Animals can really find joy in the simple things. That was so nice of you. Do you have any pictures of the new beds?
[...]
[D18:21] Andrew: Thanks! I appreciate the help. I'll keep searching for that perfect place for dogs!
[D18:22] Audrey: No worries! You got this. Don't give up. Take care!
Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023
[D19:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Long time no talk! How have you been?

Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023
[D19:4] Audrey: I petted and hugged her, spoke calmly, and slowly walked her to relax. Our bond feels even stronger when moments like these show up.
[D19:5] Andrew: She looks so adorable! That's the connection I'd like to have with Toby. Any advice on creating a strong relationship with dogs?
[D19:6] Audrey: Building trust with them needs patience and regular training. Give them time and love, and praise their successes.
[D19:7] Andrew: Thanks for the tips! Patience and practice are important for establishing a bond with our pooches, just like any other meaningful relationship. I guess some dogs just need more time! It must be so satisfying to see those successes and progress. Oh, and your pup looks so sharp in that green hat! Is there anything specific you do with them to work on training?
[...]
[D19:10] Audrey: Very often, multiple times a day even, it's a great exercise for them and great bonding time for us.
[D19:11] Andrew: Hmm that does sound like a great way to bond! What breeds are they again? Their breeds might make a difference regarding how well they bond too.
[D19:12] Audrey: They're all mutts. Two of them are Jack Russell mixes and the other two are Chihuahua mixes. And yea, I believe so! Some dog breeds do bond better than others.
[...]
[D19:30] Audrey: They really do, bringing loads of love and happiness. They are everything to me.
Session date: 7:09 pm on 1 October, 2023
[D20:1] Andrew: Hey wassup? Got some great news - the gf and I are hitting the beach next month with Toby!
[D20:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Great to hear from you. Have fun at the beach trip! Bet you can't wait to get out to the nature. Can't wait for our hike with the dogs next month. They always put a smile on my face - life's just not the same without them!
[...]
[D20:14] Audrey: Yeah, for sure. It's a great way to appreciate nature. That reminds me that I've been wanting to do some birdwatching. It's really peaceful and calming.
[D20:15] Andrew: Yeah do that! It's really peaceful and calming. It's nice to get away from the city and enjoy nature. Let me know if you need any birdwatching advice, I think I know a thing or two about bird watching. Or perhaps we can all go birdwatching soometimes.
[D20:16] Audrey: Thanks! That's so helpful, I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now I'm going with this book that writes about bird watching guides.

Session date: 9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023
[D22:13] Audrey: Thanks! I appreciate your kind words. Gotta stay strong and keep making a difference, even in challenging times.
Session date: 4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023
[D23:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, it's been a busy week for me. Last Tuesday, my gf, Toby, and I had a really awesome night playing board games. It was really nice. What's been up with you lately?
[D23:2] Audrey: Hey! Sounds like you've been busy! I made some goodies recently to thank my neighbors for their pup-friendly homes. It was a nice way to bring some joy around here. Any plans for the weekend?
[...]
[D23:12] Audrey: Haha, that must've been hilarious! What breed is your pup again? He looks so fun! My dogs love running around the park. But one thing they hate is snow. I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.
[D23:13] Andrew: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active. What games do your dogs like to play at the park?
[D23:14] Audrey: My dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, and they love to run around and meet other pups. They could keep running for hours!
[...]
[D23:17] Andrew: Yeah, they really do bring joy don't they. It's wonderful.
[D23:18] Audrey: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.
[D23:19] Andrew: Wow, that's cool! Any plans on getting more? Or are you finished?
[...]
Session date: 6:12 pm on 19 October, 2023
[D24:3] Audrey: Wow! That's awesome news! How's he doing in his new home?
[D24:4] Andrew: Thanks! He's doing great in his new home. Still getting used to Toby and the new environment. Toby needs some time to get along with him too. I never imagined having pets would bring so much happiness. Pets really bring lots of joy and companionship to our lives.
[D24:5] Audrey: That's awesome! What is his name?
[D24:6] Andrew: I named him Buddy because he's my buddy and I hope him and Toby become buddies!

Session date: 9:48 am on 8 July, 2023
[D11:38] Audrey: Yep, taking a second to appreciate those moments makes like much better!
Session date: 10:05 am on 11 July, 2023
[D12:1] Andrew: Hey! So much has changed since last time we talked - meet Toby, my puppy. He's a bundle of joy and I couldn't resist taking him home, city living and all. How've you been?
[D12:2] Audrey: OMG! Toby looks so adorable! Congrats on your new addition. I'm sure you're really happy right now! I so happy for you!
[D12:3] Andrew: Haha yeah! Toby's definitely bringing a lot of joy. Since we last talked, work has been piling up and I've been stuck inside. I miss the peace and feeling of freedom that comes with going for a hike.
[D12:4] Audrey: Yeah you're really stressed then! When work's non-stop, it's hard to get outdoors. Hiking is a great way to relax and take in nature. Do you have plans to go hiking soon? We should plan a trip for both of us and our pups!
[...]
[D12:9] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool. You really put so much love into making them, which makes them extra special.
[D12:10] Audrey: Thanks! I did put a lot of love into making these tags. I want my pets to feel seen and loved.
[D12:11] Andrew: It really are the small things like these show we care a ton about out pets.
[D12:12] Audrey: Yep! Small acts of love like that make a big difference in our relationships with our furry pals. Let's make sure they know how much we care!
[D12:13] Andrew: Definitely! They bring us so much joy, so it's only fair that we show them how special they are. Can't wait for our hike - and for Toby and your pups to meet!
[D12:14] Audrey: Can't wait either! It's going to be loads of fun and a great memory.
[D12:15] Andrew: Yep! It'll be an adventure alright.
